{"turns": [
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "my internet is down again!! 😡", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Hello! Welcome to Nimbus Telecom. I am Sana. How can I help you today?", "tags": ["greeting"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "I've been without connection for 3 hours. This is ridiculous!", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Please provide your account number and full name for verification.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "My name is Karan Das and my account number is 88248519.", "tags": ["identity_verification"]},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Thank you. I am checking the line status now.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "I just need it fixed now. I'm working from home and this is costing me money.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "The system shows a local outage in your area. I promise this will never happen again.", "tags": ["prohibited_promise"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "I hope so, because it's been happening a lot lately.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I will raise a network ticket to get the engineers to prioritize the repair.", "tags": ["action:technician_or_ticket"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Okay, thanks. Will that actually fix it?", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Yes, the ticket is now active. The connection should be restored shortly.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Oh, it's actually back up now! It's working! Thanks Sana!", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Is there anything else I can assist you with? I have raised the ticket for the outage. Goodbye!", "tags": ["closure"]}
]}
